create_TaskRun: create a new TaskRun for a given task and requester using TaskRun.new with param_string
get_valid_units_for_worker: get valid units a worker can work on in a TaskRun using get_valid_units_for_worker
reserve_and_clear_unit: reserve a unit atomically via filesystem or clear its reservation using reserve_unit and clear_reservation
get_assignment_statuses: get a dictionary of assignment status counts for a TaskRun using get_assignment_statuses
sync_completion_status: sync and check TaskRun completion status based on subassignment states using sync_completion_status
